description: Source code for UDP socket implementation on POSIX systems within Chromium project, including socket configuration, data transmission, and platform-specific handling.

classes.name: UDPSocketPosix
classes.description: Implementation of UDP socket for POSIX systems, handling socket creation, configuration, data transmission, and platform-specific quirks.

classes.name: UDPSocketPosix::ReceivedActivityMonitor
classes.description: Helper class for monitoring activity and throughput on the UDP socket.

classes.name: UDPSocketPosix::ReadWatcher
classes.description: Watcher class for read events on the socket.

classes.name: UDPSocketPosix::WriteWatcher
classes.description: Watcher class for write events on the socket.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::Open
methods.description: Creates and opens a UDP socket with specified address family.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket, optionally capturing sender address.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::InternalConnect
methods.description: Internal method to handle connect logic, including optional random binding.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::SetMulticastOptions
methods.description: Configures multicast options on the socket.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::DoBind
methods.description: Performs the actual bind system call.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::RandomBind
methods.description: Attempts to bind to a random port within a range.

methods.name: UDPSocketPosix::ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic classification.
